key_concepts: A solution is a homogeneous mixture with uniform properties throughout
Solute dissolves in a solvent; solvent dissolves the solute
Five solution types include solid-in-liquid, liquid-in-liquid, gas-in-liquid, gas-in-gas,
Air is a gas-in-gas solution of nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide, argon, and trace gases
Steel and bronze are solid-in-solid solutions
Homogeneous mixtures have one phase; heterogeneous mixtures have visibly separate phases
Muddy water and banana con yelo are heterogeneous mixtures
Mixtures do not form new compounds and their components can be separated
Filtration separates undissolved solids from liquids using a filter
Magnetic separation removes magnetic materials from nonmagnetic materials
Evaporation separates a dissolved solid from a liquid by heating
Colloids scatter light and show zigzag particle motion
